paragraphs.text: Segante Guarneri is an aspiring wizard with necromantic powers from Fiora , who was invited to join the first official multiplanar class of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . He has the potential to be a great healer or an even better killer, and aspires to become part of Witherbloom , the college of growth and decay.

Segante is a master of Essence studies from the High City of Paliano . He is skinny, has pale skin, and rough-cut black hair. His eyes have deep-brown irises around black-hole pupils. While his calculating nature means that he is slow to trust and intensely private, it also means that he is fiercely loyal to those who earn it. He brooks no insult and views everything as a competition — a competition he is going to win, no matter the cost. He smells of the Dreamwaste flowers he has brought with him from Fiora and that he arranges in his sleeping quarters. He is adept at making the flower arrangements from his homeplane that can signal various messages or threats. He can heal injuries and encourage plants to grow. The dark side of his magic allows him to extract lifeforce from objects to enhance his power or to let them rot away.
He wants to be able to return to Fiora when his time at the School is finished.

Segante was born to the noble family d'Amati on Fiora, and is a nephew of Marchesa , the queen. His father has ambitions, but knows his sister is always watching him. Segante prefers to use his mother's surname, Guarneri, to also avoid the unnecessary attention of his aunt. He was also forced to spent his childhood with his mother trapped in a single house and the surrounding grounds. This lasted until she his mother died of poisoning by one of Marchesa's men. His potential made him a liability to his father. If he were to choose to become a healer, he would be considered weak. But if he were to choose to become a killer, he would be a threat, and his aunt would never let him live.

Segante was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina because he had been identified as an ember , a potential Planeswalker , and a powerful wizard. His father agreed for him to go, because he would be out of harm's way. It is unknown if the Desparkening had any influence on his potential to ignite . This may yet come true under the right conditions.

On Arcavios, Segante formed a class with Eula Blue , who longed to share his secrets, Alandra , Jamira , and Kequia Akosa . For Segante, every relationship is transactional. He could only bond with Eula after he offered to pay her for doing his laundry. In his first year, he expanded on his knowledge and use of flowers and botanical substances. Through his essence studies, he also learned to balance growth and destruction. By order of his father, he began stealing books from the Biblioplex and sending them to Fiora,

Segante and the other multiplanar students quickly became a target for enemies within and without. Although they bonded, they found that various forces were active to isolate them emotionally from each other. However, after saving Eula from the Arcavios Preservation Society they began an intimate relationship.

In a secret plot, Professor Kasmina also endeavored to create tensions between the classmates. It was revealed that Kasmina had selected the five students because they had the potential to be powerful planeswalkers. Her underlying purpose was to force them to ignite under stressful circumstances, and to rob their sparks to reignite her own. This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl .

Afterward, Professor Vess had to task to to punish the five students for their various transgressions, with consideration of Kasmina's role. She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges, but forbade them to relocate to the appropriate dorms. This also allowed them to serve as residential advisors to the next incoming class of cross-planar students.

Segante's father made a sizable donation to the school to guarantee him a solitary room in the dorm. When Dina brings the students to their dorm, she admits that it makes the distribution of the rooms easier for her, because she had been expecting a group of all female students. Kasmina notes that he has cut his hair since she first reviewed him.

When Eula starts doing Segante's laundry, she notices Segante's preference for wearing tight-fitting vests and remembers a person from New Capenna who did the same to work as a newsboy. Segante confirms that a good essence-witch can make potions that help even before a deeper correction can be made. "A flask in the morning, another at night, and a properly fitted compression vest, and everything is as it should be." He insists on showering alone. When he first becomes intimate with Eula, she asks permission to open his vest. When she unveils his chest, she notices that one of his nipples is pierced, contrasting with a dusting a dusting of dark hair.
